title: Luxurious Russian Rice Pilaf
description: A rich, savory pilaf dish originating from Russia, made with sweet rice and fragrant spices.
instructions: Roast garlic cloves in the oven for 20 minutes, or until soft and mashed.
Caramelize onions in a pan with 2 tablespoons of clarified butter over medium heat for 25 minutes.
Cook saffron-infused sweet rice according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, cook crispy prosciutto until golden brown and crispy.
Combine roasted garlic, caramelized onions, cooked rice, and crispy prosciutto in a large bowl.
Stir in unsalted chicken broth, salt, and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh dill and serve hot.
Let the pilaf rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
